d: Short-cropped bubblegum pink hair is styled with straight bangs and a single long braid draped over the shoulder. The eyes are a pale lavender shade with a wide, cheerful expression on a youthful face. The build is petite, dressed in a white short-sleeved sailor-style dress featuring navy blue trim and a large red bow at the chest, paired with navy blue thigh-high stockings. Visible accessories include mechanical grey rigging components with dark grey canisters and a large metal cannon mounted behind the back.
